absolute-path.short_definition: An absolute path identifies a resource from a complete root location.
absolute-path.long_definition: An absolute path identifies a resource from a complete root location.

acceleration.short_definition: Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity with time and is a vector.
acceleration.long_definition: Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity with time. It is a vector, so a change in speed, direction, or both is acceleration. In calculus, acceleration is the derivative of velocity with respect to time. Because velocity is the derivative of position or displacement with respect to time, acceleration is the second derivative of position or displacement with respect to time. Common units include metres per second squared (m/s²) and feet per second squared (ft/s²).

actual-dimension.short_definition: An actual dimension is the measured size of a manufactured feature or part.
actual-dimension.long_definition: An actual dimension is the measured size of a manufactured feature or part.

additive-manufacturing.short_definition: Additive manufacturing makes an object by joining material from digital model data, usually layer by layer.
additive-manufacturing.long_definition: Additive manufacturing makes an object by joining material from digital model data, usually layer by layer.

ai-disclosure.short_definition: An AI disclosure identifies how an AI system contributed to submitted work.
ai-disclosure.long_definition: An AI disclosure identifies how an AI system contributed to submitted work.

ai-output.short_definition: AI output is content or a prediction produced by an artificial-intelligence system.
ai-output.long_definition: AI output is content or a prediction produced by an artificial-intelligence system.

alignment.short_definition: Alignment places objects or text along a shared edge, centre, axis, or reference.
alignment.long_definition: Alignment places objects or text along a shared edge, centre, axis, or reference.

alignment-template.short_definition: An alignment template positions work or marks repeatable locations during fabrication.
alignment-template.long_definition: An alignment template positions work or marks repeatable locations during fabrication.

ampere.short_definition: The ampere (A) is the SI unit of electric current.
ampere.long_definition: The ampere, symbol A, is the SI unit used to measure electric current. In basic circuit work, current values are stated in amperes or amps.

animation.short_definition: Animation creates the appearance of change or motion by presenting a sequence of images or states over time.
animation.long_definition: Animation creates the appearance of change or motion by presenting a sequence of images or states over time. Pencil2D is used in this curriculum for introductory frame-based 2D animation.

artificial-intelligence.short_definition: Artificial intelligence describes machine-based systems that produce outputs from supplied inputs for human-defined objectives.
artificial-intelligence.long_definition: Artificial intelligence describes machine-based systems that produce outputs from supplied inputs for human-defined objectives.

aspect-ratio.short_definition: Aspect ratio is the proportional relationship between an image's width and height.
aspect-ratio.long_definition: Aspect ratio is the proportional relationship between an image's width and height.

assembly.short_definition: An assembly is a collection of parts positioned and related to represent a complete product or mechanism.
assembly.long_definition: An assembly is a collection of parts positioned and related to represent a complete product or mechanism.

attribution.short_definition: Attribution identifies the creator or source of material used in a work.
attribution.long_definition: Attribution identifies the creator or source of material used in a work.

audience.short_definition: The audience is the group of people a design is intended to reach or serve.
audience.long_definition: The audience is the group of people a design is intended to reach or serve.

authoritative-source.short_definition: An authoritative source is produced by an organization or expert with recognized responsibility and expertise for the subject.
authoritative-source.long_definition: An authoritative source is produced by an organization or expert with recognized responsibility and expertise for the subject.

backer.short_definition: A backer is a supporting piece fixed behind another component to reinforce or mount it.
backer.long_definition: A backer is a supporting piece fixed behind another component to reinforce or mount it.

bias.short_definition: Bias is a systematic tendency that can produce unfair, distorted, or unrepresentative results.
bias.long_definition: Bias is a systematic tendency that can produce unfair, distorted, or unrepresentative results.

bolt.short_definition: A bolt is an externally threaded fastener normally assembled with a nut or threaded component.
bolt.long_definition: A bolt is an externally threaded fastener normally assembled with a nut or threaded component.

boolean-operation.short_definition: A Boolean operation combines or subtracts shapes using union, difference, or intersection rules.
boolean-operation.long_definition: A Boolean operation combines or subtracts shapes using union, difference, or intersection rules.

bridge.short_definition: A bridge is printed material that spans between supported regions without support directly underneath.
bridge.long_definition: A bridge is printed material that spans between supported regions without support directly underneath.

build-plate.short_definition: The build plate is the printer surface on which a 3D print is formed.
build-plate.long_definition: The build plate is the printer surface on which a 3D print is formed.

burr.short_definition: A burr is an unwanted raised edge or small piece of material left by a manufacturing process.
burr.long_definition: A burr is an unwanted raised edge or small piece of material left by a manufacturing process.

calibration.short_definition: Calibration compares a measurement or machine result with a known reference and records or corrects the difference.
calibration.long_definition: Calibration compares a measurement or machine result with a known reference and records or corrects the difference.

chamfer.short_definition: A chamfer replaces a sharp edge with a flat angled face.
chamfer.long_definition: A chamfer replaces a sharp edge with a flat angled face.

clearance.short_definition: Clearance is the intentional space between neighbouring parts or features.
clearance.long_definition: Clearance is the intentional space between neighbouring parts or features. Required clearance depends on the process, material, machine, and desired fit.

clearance-hole.short_definition: A clearance hole is large enough for a fastener's shank to pass through without thread engagement.
clearance-hole.long_definition: A clearance hole is large enough for a fastener's shank to pass through without thread engagement.

computer-aided-design.short_definition: Computer-aided design uses software to create, modify, analyse, or document a design.
computer-aided-design.long_definition: Computer-aided design uses software to create, modify, analyse, or document a design. Onshape is the primary parametric CAD tool used in this curriculum.

concept.short_definition: A design concept is a proposed overall approach to solving a design problem.
concept.long_definition: A design concept is a proposed overall approach to solving a design problem. It describes the main idea before all construction details are fixed.

constraint.short_definition: A constraint is a limit that a design must stay within.
constraint.long_definition: A constraint is a limit that a design must stay within, such as time, cost, size, material, safety, or available tools.

context.short_definition: Context is the surrounding information needed to interpret a request, statement, or result.
context.long_definition: Context is the surrounding information needed to interpret a request, statement, or result.

contrast.short_definition: Contrast is a visible difference between elements that helps them remain distinguishable.
contrast.long_definition: Contrast is a visible difference between elements that helps them remain distinguishable.

copyright.short_definition: Copyright is the legal protection given to original works, controlling specified uses such as copying and publishing.
copyright.long_definition: Copyright is the legal protection given to original works, controlling specified uses such as copying and publishing.

counterbore.short_definition: A counterbore is a flat-bottomed cylindrical recess that lets a fastener head or component sit below a surface.
counterbore.long_definition: A counterbore is a flat-bottomed cylindrical recess that lets a fastener head or component sit below a surface.

countersink.short_definition: A countersink is a conical recess that seats a matching fastener head flush with or below a surface.
countersink.long_definition: A countersink is a conical recess that seats a matching fastener head flush with or below a surface.

criterion.short_definition: A criterion is a standard used to judge whether a design succeeds.
criterion.long_definition: A criterion is a standard used to judge whether a design succeeds.

current.short_definition: Current is the rate at which electric charge flows through a circuit.
current.long_definition: Electric current is the rate at which electric charge flows through a circuit. The common quantity symbol is I and the SI unit is the ampere (A). More current means more electric charge is moving past a point each second.

deburring.short_definition: Deburring removes unwanted burrs and sharp edges left by manufacturing.
deburring.long_definition: Deburring removes unwanted burrs and sharp edges left by manufacturing.

design-brief.short_definition: A design brief states the problem, intended users, goals, and major limits of a project.
design-brief.long_definition: A design brief states the problem, intended users, goals, and major limits of a project.

design-intent.short_definition: Design intent is the planned way a model should behave when dimensions or features change.
design-intent.long_definition: Design intent is the planned way a model should behave when dimensions or features change.

dimension.short_definition: A dimension gives a measured or specified size, distance, angle, or location.
dimension.long_definition: A dimension gives a measured or specified size, distance, angle, or location.

displacement.short_definition: Displacement is the change in position from a starting point to an ending point, including direction.
displacement.long_definition: Displacement is a vector that describes the change in position from a starting point to an ending point. It has both magnitude and direction and does not depend on the total path travelled.

distance.short_definition: Distance is the total length of the path travelled.
distance.long_definition: Distance is a scalar measure of the total length of the path travelled. It has magnitude but no direction. Common units include metres (m), kilometres (km), feet (ft), and miles (mi).

distribution.short_definition: Distribution spaces selected objects evenly along a direction or between reference points.
distribution.long_definition: Distribution spaces selected objects evenly along a direction or between reference points.

dowel.short_definition: A dowel is a cylindrical pin used to align, locate, or join parts.
dowel.long_definition: A dowel is a cylindrical pin used to align, locate, or join parts.

drilling-template.short_definition: A drilling template guides hole positions so a pattern can be transferred or repeated accurately.
drilling-template.long_definition: A drilling template guides hole positions so a pattern can be transferred or repeated accurately.

edge.short_definition: An edge is a line segment that connects two vertices and bounds faces in a polygon mesh.
edge.long_definition: An edge is a line segment that connects two vertices and bounds faces in a polygon mesh.

engineering-design-process.short_definition: The engineering design process is an iterative way to identify needs, create solutions, test them, and improve them.
engineering-design-process.long_definition: The engineering design process is a flexible, iterative approach to solving problems. A typical cycle identifies the problem and needs, investigates existing information and solutions, develops ideas, creates or prototypes a solution, tests and evaluates it, communicates results, and improves the design. The process can loop backward or repeat whenever new evidence changes what the design needs.

engraving.short_definition: Laser engraving removes or alters a surface to create a visible recessed mark or image.
engraving.long_definition: Laser engraving removes or alters a surface to create a visible recessed mark or image.

evaluation.short_definition: Evaluation compares a design or result with its criteria and evidence.
evaluation.long_definition: Evaluation compares a design or result with its criteria and evidence.

evidence.short_definition: Evidence is information used to support a conclusion or design decision.
evidence.long_definition: Evidence is information used to support a conclusion or design decision.

extrude.short_definition: Extrude creates or removes three-dimensional volume by extending a sketch region in a direction.
extrude.long_definition: Extrude creates or removes three-dimensional volume by extending a sketch region in a direction.

face.short_definition: A face is a surface region bounded by edges in a polygon mesh.
face.long_definition: A face is a surface region bounded by edges in a polygon mesh.

fastener.short_definition: A fastener is hardware used to join or secure two or more parts.
fastener.long_definition: A fastener is hardware used to join or secure two or more parts.

feature.short_definition: A feature is a modelling operation that creates or changes part geometry.
feature.long_definition: A feature is a modelling operation that creates or changes part geometry.

feedback.short_definition: Feedback is information about a design's performance or effect that can guide revision.
feedback.long_definition: Feedback is information about a design's performance or effect that can guide revision.

feet-per-second-squared.short_definition: Feet per second squared (ft/s²) is a non-SI unit of acceleration.
feet-per-second-squared.long_definition: Feet per second squared, written ft/s², is a common non-SI unit of acceleration.

file-path.short_definition: A file path identifies the location of a file or folder in a file system.
file-path.long_definition: A file path identifies the location of a file or folder in a file system.

fill.short_definition: Fill is the paint applied to the interior of a vector shape.
fill.long_definition: Fill is the paint applied to the interior of a vector shape.

fillet.short_definition: A fillet replaces a sharp edge with a rounded transition.
fillet.long_definition: A fillet replaces a sharp edge with a rounded transition.

fit.short_definition: Fit describes how tightly or freely mating parts go together.
fit.long_definition: Fit describes how tightly or freely mating parts go together.

fit-gauge.short_definition: A fit gauge contains test features used to compare mating sizes and choose a working fit.
fit-gauge.long_definition: A fit gauge contains test features used to compare mating sizes and choose a working fit.

focus.short_definition: Laser focus is the position where the beam is concentrated to a small spot on or near the material surface.
focus.long_definition: Laser focus is the position where the beam is concentrated to a small spot on or near the material surface.

frame.short_definition: A frame is one position in an animation timeline that can hold or display image content.
frame.long_definition: A frame is one position in an animation timeline that can hold or display image content.

frame-rate.short_definition: Frame rate is the number of animation frames presented per second.
frame-rate.long_definition: Frame rate is the number of animation frames presented per second.

french-cleat.short_definition: A French cleat is a mounting system that hangs an object from matching interlocking bevelled strips.
french-cleat.long_definition: A French cleat is a mounting system that hangs an object from matching interlocking bevelled strips.

front-view.short_definition: A front view is an orthographic view looking directly at the chosen front of an object.
front-view.long_definition: A front view is an orthographic view looking directly at the chosen front of an object.

generative-ai.short_definition: Generative AI is artificial intelligence that produces synthetic content such as text, images, audio, video, or code.
generative-ai.long_definition: Generative AI is artificial intelligence that produces synthetic content such as text, images, audio, video, or code.

geometric-constraint.short_definition: A geometric constraint limits or fixes relationships between entities in a CAD sketch.
geometric-constraint.long_definition: A geometric constraint limits or fixes relationships between entities in a CAD sketch.

gusset.short_definition: A gusset is a plate or bracket that reinforces the connection between structural members.
gusset.long_definition: A gusset is a plate or bracket that reinforces the connection between structural members.

hallucination.short_definition: A hallucination is confidently presented AI output that is false or inconsistent with the supplied information.
hallucination.long_definition: A hallucination is confidently presented AI output that is false or inconsistent with the supplied information.

hinge.short_definition: A hinge is a joint that permits controlled rotation between connected parts.
hinge.long_definition: A hinge is a joint that permits controlled rotation between connected parts.

human-oversight.short_definition: Human oversight is meaningful human review and control of an automated system and its effects.
human-oversight.long_definition: Human oversight is meaningful human review and control of an automated system and its effects.

hyperlink.short_definition: A hyperlink connects a user from one web resource or location to another.
hyperlink.long_definition: A hyperlink connects a user from one web resource or location to another.

hypertext-markup-language.short_definition: HTML is the markup language used to define the structure and meaning of web content.
hypertext-markup-language.long_definition: HTML is the markup language used to define the structure and meaning of web content.

image-dimensions.short_definition: Image dimensions state an image's width and height, usually in pixels for raster images.
image-dimensions.long_definition: Image dimensions state an image's width and height, usually in pixels for raster images.

image-resolution.short_definition: Image resolution describes the amount of pixel detail in a raster image.
image-resolution.long_definition: Image resolution describes the amount of pixel detail in a raster image.

infill.short_definition: Infill is the internal printed structure inside a part's outer walls.
infill.long_definition: Infill is the internal printed structure inside a part's outer walls.

interface-state.short_definition: Interface state is the current condition of an interface or control, such as selected, disabled, loading, or complete.
interface-state.long_definition: Interface state is the current condition of an interface or control, such as selected, disabled, loading, or complete.

investigation.short_definition: Investigation gathers and examines information needed to understand a design problem.
investigation.long_definition: Investigation gathers and examines information needed to understand a design problem.

isometric-view.short_definition: An isometric view represents three principal dimensions using equally scaled axes.
isometric-view.long_definition: An isometric view represents three principal dimensions using equally scaled axes.

iteration.short_definition: Iteration is a repeated cycle of testing, evaluating, and revising a design.
iteration.long_definition: Iteration is a repeated cycle of testing, evaluating, and revising a design.

joint.short_definition: A joint is the connection where two or more parts meet and transfer load or maintain alignment.
joint.long_definition: A joint is the connection where two or more parts meet and transfer load or maintain alignment.

jpeg.short_definition: JPEG is a raster image format that uses lossy compression and is commonly used for photographs.
jpeg.long_definition: JPEG is a raster image format that uses lossy compression and is commonly used for photographs.

kerf.short_definition: Kerf is the width of material removed by a cutting process.
kerf.long_definition: Kerf is the width of material removed by a cutting process. Laser kerf varies with the machine, material, thickness, focus, power, speed, and other settings.

keyframe.short_definition: A keyframe stores a defined image or property value at a specific point in an animation timeline.
keyframe.long_definition: A keyframe stores a defined image or property value at a specific point in an animation timeline.

kilometres-per-hour.short_definition: Kilometres per hour (km/h) is a common unit of speed and velocity.
kilometres-per-hour.long_definition: Kilometres per hour, written km/h, states how many kilometres are covered in one hour. It is commonly used for road speed in Canada and many other countries. When a direction is included, it can also be used for velocity.

laser-cutter.short_definition: A laser cutter is a computer-controlled machine that uses a focused laser beam to cut, score, or engrave material.
laser-cutter.long_definition: A laser cutter is a computer-controlled machine that uses a focused laser beam to cut, score, or engrave material.

laser-cutting.short_definition: Laser cutting separates material along a programmed path using energy from a focused laser beam.
laser-cutting.long_definition: Laser cutting separates material along a programmed path using energy from a focused laser beam.

layer.short_definition: A layer is one deposited cross-section of a 3D-printed object.
layer.long_definition: A layer is one deposited cross-section of a 3D-printed object.

layer-height.short_definition: Layer height is the vertical thickness assigned to each printed layer.
layer-height.long_definition: Layer height is the vertical thickness assigned to each printed layer.

lettermark.short_definition: A lettermark is a logo built mainly from letters or initials.
lettermark.long_definition: A lettermark is a logo built mainly from letters or initials.

licence.short_definition: A licence grants permission to use a protected work under stated conditions.
licence.long_definition: A licence grants permission to use a protected work under stated conditions.

logo.short_definition: A logo is a visual mark used to identify an organization, product, project, or person.
logo.long_definition: A logo is a visual mark used to identify an organization, product, project, or person.

loop.short_definition: A loop repeats an animation sequence from its beginning after it reaches the end.
loop.long_definition: A loop repeats an animation sequence from its beginning after it reaches the end.

loose-fit.short_definition: A loose fit leaves enough clearance for mating parts to move or assemble freely.
loose-fit.long_definition: A loose fit leaves enough clearance for mating parts to move or assemble freely.

material-thickness.short_definition: Material thickness is the measured distance between a sheet's two main surfaces.
material-thickness.long_definition: Material thickness is the measured distance between a sheet's two main surfaces.

metre.short_definition: The metre (m) is the SI base unit of length.
metre.long_definition: The metre, symbol m, is the SI base unit used to measure length. In motion problems it can describe distance or displacement.

metres-per-second.short_definition: Metres per second (m/s) is a unit of speed and velocity.
metres-per-second.long_definition: Metres per second, written m/s, tells how many metres of distance or displacement are covered each second. It is a common SI unit for both speed and velocity.

metres-per-second-squared.short_definition: Metres per second squared (m/s²) is a unit of acceleration.
metres-per-second-squared.long_definition: Metres per second squared, written m/s², is a unit of acceleration. A value of 1 m/s² means velocity changes by 1 metre per second during each second.

miles-per-hour.short_definition: Miles per hour (mph) is a common non-SI unit of speed and velocity.
miles-per-hour.long_definition: Miles per hour, written mph, states how many miles are covered in one hour. It is common in U.S. customary and some Imperial contexts. When a direction is included, it can also be used for velocity.

mirror.short_definition: Mirror copies geometry across a selected line, plane, or face.
mirror.long_definition: Mirror copies geometry across a selected line, plane, or face.

modifier.short_definition: A modifier applies a non-destructive operation that changes how Blender geometry is evaluated or displayed.
modifier.long_definition: A modifier applies a non-destructive operation that changes how Blender geometry is evaluated or displayed.

navigation.short_definition: Navigation is the set of controls and paths that lets users move through content or tasks.
navigation.long_definition: Navigation is the set of controls and paths that lets users move through content or tasks.

necessity.short_definition: A necessity is a requirement that must be met for a design to be acceptable.
necessity.long_definition: A necessity is a requirement that must be met for a design to be acceptable.

need.short_definition: A need is a problem or condition that a design is intended to address.
need.long_definition: A need is a problem or condition that a design is intended to address.

negative-space.short_definition: Negative space is the unoccupied area around or within visible shapes.
negative-space.long_definition: Negative space is the unoccupied area around or within visible shapes.

nice-design-process.short_definition: N.I.C.E. is a classroom design cycle: Needs & Necessities → Investigate & Inquire → Create & Communicate → Evaluate → repeat.
nice-design-process.long_definition: The N.I.C.E. Design Process is a classroom design cycle used in these resources: Needs & Necessities → Investigate & Inquire → Create & Communicate → Evaluate → repeat. It begins with what the design actually needs to accomplish, uses inquiry and investigation before choosing a solution, makes and communicates the solution, and uses evaluation to return to the needs and improve the next version.

nice-to-have.short_definition: A nice-to-have is a desirable feature that is not required for the design to succeed.
nice-to-have.long_definition: A nice-to-have is a desirable feature that is not required for the design to succeed.

node.short_definition: A node is an editable point that defines part of a vector path.
node.long_definition: A node is an editable point that defines part of a vector path.

nominal-dimension.short_definition: A nominal dimension is the stated or target size used to identify a feature or part.
nominal-dimension.long_definition: A nominal dimension is the stated or target size used to identify a feature or part.

nut.short_definition: A nut is an internally threaded fastener used with a matching bolt or threaded part.
nut.long_definition: A nut is an internally threaded fastener used with a matching bolt or threaded part.

ohm.short_definition: The ohm (Ω) is the SI unit of electrical resistance.
ohm.long_definition: The ohm, symbol Ω, is the SI unit used to measure electrical resistance. In a simple resistive circuit, 1 ohm of resistance allows 1 ampere of current when 1 volt is applied.

onion-skinning.short_definition: Onion skinning displays nearby animation frames as faint overlays to guide the current drawing.
onion-skinning.long_definition: Onion skinning displays nearby animation frames as faint overlays to guide the current drawing.

orthographic-projection.short_definition: Orthographic projection represents an object with separate perpendicular views without perspective shortening.
orthographic-projection.long_definition: Orthographic projection represents an object with separate perpendicular views without perspective shortening.

overhang.short_definition: An overhang is geometry that extends outward beyond the layer below it.
overhang.long_definition: An overhang is geometry that extends outward beyond the layer below it.

parametric-modelling.short_definition: Parametric modelling controls geometry with dimensions, constraints, and ordered features that can be edited.
parametric-modelling.long_definition: Parametric modelling controls geometry with dimensions, constraints, and ordered features that can be edited.

part.short_definition: A part is one distinct solid component represented in a CAD model.
part.long_definition: A part is one distinct solid component represented in a CAD model.

pattern.short_definition: A pattern creates repeated copies of geometry or features using defined spacing or rotation.
pattern.long_definition: A pattern creates repeated copies of geometry or features using defined spacing or rotation.

perimeter-wall.short_definition: A perimeter wall is an outer shell printed around a layer's interior.
perimeter-wall.long_definition: A perimeter wall is an outer shell printed around a layer's interior.

personal-information.short_definition: Personal information is recorded information about an identifiable individual.
personal-information.long_definition: Personal information is recorded information about an identifiable individual.

pilot-hole.short_definition: A pilot hole is a smaller hole drilled before a screw or larger cutting tool to guide it and reduce splitting or wandering.
pilot-hole.long_definition: A pilot hole is a smaller hole drilled before a screw or larger cutting tool to guide it and reduce splitting or wandering.

pixel.short_definition: A pixel is one addressable picture element in a raster image or display.
pixel.long_definition: A pixel is one addressable picture element in a raster image or display.

png.short_definition: PNG is a lossless raster image format that supports transparency.
png.long_definition: PNG is a lossless raster image format that supports transparency.

polygon-mesh.short_definition: A polygon mesh represents a surface using vertices, edges, and faces.
polygon-mesh.long_definition: A polygon mesh represents a surface using vertices, edges, and faces. Blender is used in this curriculum for artistic mesh modelling, rendering, and animation.

position.short_definition: Position describes where an object is relative to a chosen reference point.
position.long_definition: Position describes an object's location relative to a chosen reference point or coordinate system. A change in position is displacement.

power.short_definition: Power is the rate at which energy is transferred or used.
power.long_definition: Power describes how quickly energy is transferred or used. The SI unit is the watt (W). In a DC electrical circuit, power can be calculated with P = V × I, where V is voltage and I is current.

press-fit.short_definition: A press fit uses interference between mating parts so assembly requires force and resists separation.
press-fit.long_definition: A press fit uses interference between mating parts so assembly requires force and resists separation.

primary-source.short_definition: A primary source is original evidence or a first-hand record created by a direct participant, authority, or system.
primary-source.long_definition: A primary source is original evidence or a first-hand record created by a direct participant, authority, or system.

print-orientation.short_definition: Print orientation is the direction and position in which a model is placed on the build plate.
print-orientation.long_definition: Print orientation is the direction and position in which a model is placed on the build plate.

privacy.short_definition: Privacy is a person's ability to control how information about them is collected, used, disclosed, and retained.
privacy.long_definition: Privacy is a person's ability to control how information about them is collected, used, disclosed, and retained.

prompt.short_definition: A prompt is input that instructs or provides context to a generative-AI system.
prompt.long_definition: A prompt is input that instructs or provides context to a generative-AI system.

prototype.short_definition: A prototype is a model or early version built to test a design idea.
prototype.long_definition: A prototype is a model or early version built to test a design idea. It may test only selected features rather than reproduce the final product.

provenance.short_definition: Provenance records where content or data came from and how it changed.
provenance.long_definition: Provenance records where content or data came from and how it changed.

purpose.short_definition: Purpose is the intended function or reason for creating a design.
purpose.long_definition: Purpose is the intended function or reason for creating a design.

raster-engraving.short_definition: Raster engraving scans across an image area in rows to reproduce tones or filled regions on a surface.
raster-engraving.long_definition: Raster engraving scans across an image area in rows to reproduce tones or filled regions on a surface.

raster-image.short_definition: A raster image stores an image as a grid of pixels.
raster-image.long_definition: A raster image stores an image as a grid of pixels.

relative-path.short_definition: A relative path locates a resource from the location of the current file or document.
relative-path.long_definition: A relative path locates a resource from the location of the current file or document.

rendering.short_definition: Rendering calculates a final image from a three-dimensional scene, its materials, lights, and camera.
rendering.long_definition: Rendering calculates a final image from a three-dimensional scene, its materials, lights, and camera.

reproducibility.short_definition: Reproducibility is the ability to obtain a consistent result by following the documented inputs and procedure.
reproducibility.long_definition: Reproducibility is the ability to obtain a consistent result by following the documented inputs and procedure.

requirement.short_definition: A requirement is a condition or capability that a design must satisfy.
requirement.long_definition: A requirement is a condition or capability that a design must satisfy.

resistance.short_definition: Resistance is opposition to electric current.
resistance.long_definition: Electrical resistance describes how strongly a component or material opposes electric current. The common quantity symbol is R and the SI unit is the ohm (Ω). For a simple resistive circuit, voltage, current, and resistance are related by V = I × R.

responsive-design.short_definition: Responsive design adapts a webpage's layout to different viewport sizes and device capabilities.
responsive-design.long_definition: Responsive design adapts a webpage's layout to different viewport sizes and device capabilities.

revolve.short_definition: Revolve creates or removes three-dimensional volume by rotating a sketch region around an axis.
revolve.long_definition: Revolve creates or removes three-dimensional volume by rotating a sketch region around an axis.

scalable-vector-graphics.short_definition: SVG is a text-based web format for describing two-dimensional vector graphics.
scalable-vector-graphics.long_definition: SVG is a text-based web format for describing two-dimensional vector graphics. Inkscape can edit SVG paths and document dimensions for this curriculum's fabrication workflows.

scalar.short_definition: A scalar is a quantity with magnitude but no direction.
scalar.long_definition: A scalar is a quantity that has magnitude but no direction. Distance, speed, time, and temperature are common scalar quantities.

scoring.short_definition: Laser scoring marks a vector path on the surface without cutting fully through the material.
scoring.long_definition: Laser scoring marks a vector path on the surface without cutting fully through the material.

screw.short_definition: A screw is an externally threaded fastener that forms or engages threads to hold parts together.
screw.long_definition: A screw is an externally threaded fastener that forms or engages threads to hold parts together.

sculpting.short_definition: Sculpting reshapes a digital mesh with brush-like tools that push, pull, smooth, or add surface detail.
sculpting.long_definition: Sculpting reshapes a digital mesh with brush-like tools that push, pull, smooth, or add surface detail.

serviceability.short_definition: Serviceability is the ease with which a product can be inspected, maintained, repaired, or have parts replaced.
serviceability.long_definition: Serviceability is the ease with which a product can be inspected, maintained, repaired, or have parts replaced.

set-focus.short_definition: Set Focus measures the distance from a Glowforge print head to a selected point on the material before printing.
set-focus.long_definition: Set Focus measures the distance from a Glowforge print head to a selected point on the material before printing.

side-view.short_definition: A side view is an orthographic view looking directly at one side of an object.
side-view.long_definition: A side view is an orthographic view looking directly at one side of an object.

sketch.short_definition: A CAD sketch is a two-dimensional set of geometric entities used to define or drive model features.
sketch.long_definition: A CAD sketch is a two-dimensional set of geometric entities used to define or drive model features.

slicer.short_definition: A slicer converts a 3D model into layered machine instructions and print settings.
slicer.long_definition: A slicer converts a 3D model into layered machine instructions and print settings.

sliding-fit.short_definition: A sliding fit provides clearance for mating parts to move against each other with limited play.
sliding-fit.long_definition: A sliding fit provides clearance for mating parts to move against each other with limited play.

slot.short_definition: A slot is a narrow opening designed to receive a tab, fastener, or moving feature.
slot.long_definition: A slot is a narrow opening designed to receive a tab, fastener, or moving feature.

snug-fit.short_definition: A snug fit holds mating parts with little play while still allowing assembly without a heavy press.
snug-fit.long_definition: A snug fit holds mating parts with little play while still allowing assembly without a heavy press.

solid-modelling.short_definition: Solid modelling represents a closed three-dimensional volume rather than only its visible surface.
solid-modelling.long_definition: Solid modelling represents a closed three-dimensional volume rather than only its visible surface.

source.short_definition: A source is the person, record, publication, dataset, or system from which information comes.
source.long_definition: A source is the person, record, publication, dataset, or system from which information comes.

spacer.short_definition: A spacer maintains a specified distance between parts.
spacer.long_definition: A spacer maintains a specified distance between parts.

specification.short_definition: A specification states measurable requirements for a design, part, material, or process.
specification.long_definition: A specification states measurable requirements for a design, part, material, or process.

speed.short_definition: Speed is the rate of change of distance with time.
speed.long_definition: Speed is a scalar: it has magnitude but no direction. It is the rate of change of distance with time. In calculus, speed is the derivative of distance travelled with respect to time. Common units include metres per second (m/s), kilometres per hour (km/h), and miles per hour (mph).

step-file.short_definition: A STEP file exchanges structured product-model geometry between CAD systems.
step-file.long_definition: A STEP file exchanges structured product-model geometry between CAD systems.

stl.short_definition: STL is a file format that represents a model's surface as a set of triangles.
stl.long_definition: STL is a file format that represents a model's surface as a set of triangles.

stroke.short_definition: Stroke is the painted outline of a vector path or shape.
stroke.long_definition: Stroke is the painted outline of a vector path or shape.

support-material.short_definition: Support material is temporary printed structure that holds up geometry that cannot print reliably on its own.
support-material.long_definition: Support material is temporary printed structure that holds up geometry that cannot print reliably on its own.

tab.short_definition: A tab is a projecting feature designed to locate in a matching slot or opening.
tab.long_definition: A tab is a projecting feature designed to locate in a matching slot or opening.

template.short_definition: A template is a reusable guide for locating, shaping, or checking features.
template.long_definition: A template is a reusable guide for locating, shaping, or checking features.

test-coupon.short_definition: A test coupon is a small sample made with the intended material and process to check settings or dimensions.
test-coupon.long_definition: A test coupon is a small sample made with the intended material and process to check settings or dimensions.

test-print.short_definition: A test print is a small or simplified print used to check settings, fit, or geometry before the final print.
test-print.long_definition: A test print is a small or simplified print used to check settings, fit, or geometry before the final print.

three-d-printing.short_definition: 3D printing makes physical objects from digital models by adding material through an automated process.
three-d-printing.long_definition: 3D printing makes physical objects from digital models by adding material through an automated process.

three-mf.short_definition: 3MF is a 3D-manufacturing file format that can package model geometry, units, materials, and other production information.
three-mf.long_definition: 3MF is a 3D-manufacturing file format that can package model geometry, units, materials, and other production information.

timeline.short_definition: A timeline arranges animation frames and changes in time order.
timeline.long_definition: A timeline arranges animation frames and changes in time order.

tolerance.short_definition: Tolerance is the permitted variation from a specified dimension or value.
tolerance.long_definition: Tolerance is the permitted variation from a specified dimension or value.

top-view.short_definition: A top view is an orthographic view looking directly down at an object.
top-view.long_definition: A top view is an orthographic view looking directly down at an object.

trade-off.short_definition: A trade-off accepts a disadvantage in one area to gain an advantage in another.
trade-off.long_definition: A trade-off accepts a disadvantage in one area to gain an advantage in another.

transparency.short_definition: Transparency allows image content to be partly or fully see-through.
transparency.long_definition: Transparency allows image content to be partly or fully see-through.

typography.short_definition: Typography is the selection and arrangement of type to communicate written information.
typography.long_definition: Typography is the selection and arrangement of type to communicate written information.

uniform-resource-locator.short_definition: A URL is an address that identifies where a resource can be found and how it can be accessed.
uniform-resource-locator.long_definition: A URL is an address that identifies where a resource can be found and how it can be accessed.

user-experience.short_definition: User experience is a person's overall experience while using a product, system, or service.
user-experience.long_definition: User experience is a person's overall experience while using a product, system, or service.

user-flow.short_definition: A user flow is the sequence of steps a user follows to complete a task.
user-flow.long_definition: A user flow is the sequence of steps a user follows to complete a task.

user-interface.short_definition: A user interface is the controls and information through which a person interacts with a system.
user-interface.long_definition: A user interface is the controls and information through which a person interacts with a system.

vector.short_definition: A vector is a quantity with both magnitude and direction.
vector.long_definition: A vector is a quantity with both magnitude and direction. Displacement, velocity, and acceleration are vector quantities.

vector-cut.short_definition: A vector cut follows vector paths to separate material along defined lines.
vector-cut.long_definition: A vector cut follows vector paths to separate material along defined lines.

vector-graphic.short_definition: A vector graphic describes shapes with geometric paths rather than a fixed grid of pixels.
vector-graphic.long_definition: A vector graphic describes shapes with geometric paths rather than a fixed grid of pixels.

vector-path.short_definition: A vector path is a geometric outline made from line or curve segments.
vector-path.long_definition: A vector path is a geometric outline made from line or curve segments.

velocity.short_definition: Velocity is the rate of change of displacement with time and is a vector.
velocity.long_definition: Velocity is the rate of change of displacement with time. It is a vector, so it has both magnitude and direction. The SI unit is metres per second (m/s); common everyday units can also include kilometres per hour (km/h) or miles per hour (mph) when a direction is included. For example, 100 km/h north while driving northbound on Highway 410 describes a velocity, while 100 km/h by itself describes only speed.

verification.short_definition: Verification checks a claim, output, or result against evidence and requirements.
verification.long_definition: Verification checks a claim, output, or result against evidence and requirements.

vertex.short_definition: A vertex is a point that defines a corner or location in a polygon mesh.
vertex.long_definition: A vertex is a point that defines a corner or location in a polygon mesh.

visual-hierarchy.short_definition: Visual hierarchy uses differences such as size, position, spacing, and contrast to show reading order and importance.
visual-hierarchy.long_definition: Visual hierarchy uses differences such as size, position, spacing, and contrast to show reading order and importance.

volt.short_definition: The volt (V) is the SI unit of electric potential difference.
volt.long_definition: The volt, symbol V, is the SI unit used to measure electric potential difference, commonly called voltage. One volt is one joule of energy per coulomb of electric charge.

voltage.short_definition: Voltage is electric potential difference: energy transferred per unit charge.
voltage.long_definition: Voltage is the electric potential difference between two points. It describes energy transferred per unit charge. The SI unit is the volt (V). In introductory circuit work, voltage is sometimes described as electrical push, but potential difference is the more precise idea.

washer.short_definition: A washer is a thin part placed under a fastener head or nut to distribute load, protect a surface, or provide another specified function.
washer.long_definition: A washer is a thin part placed under a fastener head or nut to distribute load, protect a surface, or provide another specified function.

watt.short_definition: The watt (W) is the SI unit of power.
watt.long_definition: The watt, symbol W, is the SI unit used to measure power. One watt means one joule of energy is transferred or used each second.

web-browser.short_definition: A web browser retrieves and presents web resources and provides controls for navigating them.
web-browser.long_definition: A web browser retrieves and presents web resources and provides controls for navigating them.

web-server.short_definition: A web server receives network requests and returns web resources such as HTML, images, and stylesheets.
web-server.long_definition: A web server receives network requests and returns web resources such as HTML, images, and stylesheets.

webpage.short_definition: A webpage is a document or application presented by a web browser at a URL.
webpage.long_definition: A webpage is a document or application presented by a web browser at a URL.

website.short_definition: A website is a related collection of webpages and resources published under a common identity or location.
website.long_definition: A website is a related collection of webpages and resources published under a common identity or location.
